settings.heading: Original makeup you can trust in Egypt
settings.body: Counterfeit beauty is a real risk online. At Sofie's Makeup Store, originality is our promise: every product is genuine, sourced from official brands and authorized distributors. For over 10 years, customers across Egypt have trusted us for original makeup.

settings.heading: How we guarantee originality
settings.body:
• We buy only through official brands and authorized distributors.
  • Our team has 10+ years of prestige-beauty expertise.
  • You can see and shop our products in person at Marassi M-Porium & Akti by Zahra.

settings.intro: Shop original, 100% authentic makeup in Egypt at Sofie's Makeup Store. We guarantee every product is genuine — sourced from official brands and authorized distributors, with 10+ years of trust.

settings.question: Is your makeup original?
settings.answer: Yes — 100% original and authentic, sourced from official brands and authorized distributors.

settings.question: How do I know the makeup is not fake?
settings.answer: We source exclusively through authorized channels, have a 10+ year track record, and operate physical boutiques you can visit in Egypt.
